_about: SHELF of Babylonian, Assyrian and Sumerian texts in English before 1931: the Epic of Gilgamesh three ways (Thompson's hexameters 1928, Jastrow and Clay's Yale tablet 1920, Langdon's Pennsylvania tablet 1917) and the British Museum's Deluge and Gilgamish (1920); Langdon's Sumerian Epic of Paradise (1915), Sumerian Liturgies and Psalms (1919) and Babylonian Epic of Creation (1923); Campbell Thompson's Devils and Evil Spirits of Babylonia (1903-04); Harper's Code of Hammurabi (1904) and his anthology Assyrian and Babylonian Literature (1901). King's Seven Tablets and Johns's Hammurabi are on the reading-lists branch. Each title gates on its own translator. Printings before 1931 only; the AMS Press reprint of 1976 is not used. US public domain. Added 2026-10-17 by lane C (round 73); Adam may veto. No uids minted.
